crew.overview: The invasion of a village in Byelorussia by German forces sends young Florya into the forest to join the weary Resistance fighters, against his family's wishes. There he meets a girl, Glasha, who accompanies him back to his village. On returning home, Florya finds his family and fellow peasants massacred. His continued survival amidst the brutal debris of war becomes increasingly nightmarish, a battle between despair and hope.
crew.title: Come and See

details.biography: Valeriya Belova was born on 14 December 1938 in Moscow, USSR. She is an editor, known for Come and See, The Ascent and Office Romance.
details.name: Valeriya Belova
